description: Source code for AST metadata analysis related to gradient usage, control flow, and discontinuous loops in shader compilation, specifically for HLSL generation within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: PullGradient
classes.description: Traverses AST to detect gradient usage and control flow containing gradients.

classes.name: PullComputeDiscontinuousAndGradientLoops
classes.description: Analyzes AST to identify loops and if statements with gradient loops.

classes.name: PushDiscontinuousLoops
classes.description: Tags functions called within discontinuous loops.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Traverses function definitions or AST nodes to analyze gradient and loop usage.

methods.name: onGradient
methods.description: Marks the current context as using a gradient.

methods.name: visitControlFlow
methods.description: Handles control flow nodes during traversal.

methods.name: hasGradientInCallGraph
methods.description: Checks if a loop node is in the gradient call graph.

methods.name: hasGradientLoop
methods.description: Checks if an if-else node contains a gradient loop.

methods.name: CreateASTMetadataHLSL
methods.description: Main function to create metadata about AST regarding gradients and control flow.
